entities.name: Kolvori
entities.description: The god of kinship from Kaldheim, youngest child of Cosima and Alrund, who keeps the Skoti sagas and mediates among her family.

entities.name: Egon
entities.description: A god who shares Kolvori's concern for the Skoti but can barely stand her company.

entities.name: Ringhart Crest
entities.description: Magical cloak clasp with animal carvings worn by Kolvori.

relations.note: She is the youngest child of Cosima and Alrund.
relations.quote: The youngest child of Cosima and Alrund
